versions.content: Handling if attempts to enable / disable the transmission secure association at an Ethernet switch port has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecAddTxSa was called for an EthSwtPort with EthSwtPortMac- SecEnabled set to TRUE and attempts to add a transmission secure association and to enable or disable of this transmission secure association for the corresponding Eth- ernet switch port has been successfully finalized, then the EthSwt driver shall notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddTxSaNotification with SwitchIdx of MgmtInfoPtr set to to the corresponding EthIfSwitchIdx and SwitchIdx of MgmtInfoPtr set to the EthSwtPortIdx and Result set to E_OK . Otherwise the EthSwt driver shall call EthIf_SwitchMacSecAddTxSaNotification with Re- sult set to E_NOT_OK .
